title: Promises (const)
instructions: const in front of a box is a promise: this box will never change.
If any line tries to change it, the computer refuses to build the program. That's a good thing: it caught a mistake!
Run it first and read what the computer says.
task: The program breaks its own promise. Delete the line that changes lives, so it builds and prints:  Lives: 3
hint:
A const box can't change, so remove this line:

    lives = lives + 1;
